name: A_n16_s0
xml:
<mujoco model="cloth_table">
  <option timestep="0.0041666667" solver="CG" iterations="50" integrator="discrete" cone="pyramidal"/>
  <visual><global offwidth="640" offheight="480"/><quality shadowsize="0"/>
    <headlight ambient="0.45 0.45 0.45" diffuse="0.5 0.5 0.5" specular="0 0 0"/></visual>
  <asset>
    <texture name="cloth_tex" type="2d" builtin="checker" rgb1="0.90 0.30 0.20" rgb2="0.95 0.85 0.30"
             width="256" height="256"/>
    <material name="cloth_mat" texture="cloth_tex" texrepeat="4 4" specular="0" shininess="0"/>
    <material name="table_mat" rgba="0.55 0.55 0.6 1" specular="0" shininess="0"/>
    </asset>
  <worldbody>
    <!-- 机: 見た目は箱、布との衝突は平面（箱だと三角形ごとに約 3 点の接触ができ、平面だと頂点ごとに 1 点） -->
    <geom name="table_vis" type="box" size="0.4 0.4 0.02" pos="0 0 -0.0201" material="table_mat" contype="0" conaffinity="0"/>
    <geom name="table" type="plane" size="0.4 0.4 0.02" rgba="0 0 0 0" friction="0.6 0.005 0.0001"/>
    <camera name="top" pos="0 0 0.55" xyaxes="1 0 0 0 1 0" fovy="45"/>
    <camera name="side" pos="0 -0.55 0.18" xyaxes="1 0 0 0 0.3 1" fovy="45"/>
    
    <body name="grip_a" mocap="true" pos="0 0 0.3"><geom type="sphere" size="0.006" rgba="0.1 0.6 0.9 0.6" contype="0" conaffinity="0"/></body>
<body name="grip_b" mocap="true" pos="0 0 0.3"><geom type="sphere" size="0.006" rgba="0.1 0.6 0.9 0.6" contype="0" conaffinity="0"/></body>
    
    <flexcomp name="cloth" type="grid" count="16 16 1" spacing="0.016 0.016 0.016" dim="2"
              radius="0.002" mass="0.02" pos="0.00723647 0.000880868 0.003"
              euler="0 0 1.01964" material="cloth_mat">
      <edge equality="true" damping="0.0"/>
      <elasticity young="5000" poisson="0" thickness="0.001" damping="0" elastic2d="bend"/>
      <contact selfcollide="auto" friction="0.6 0.005 0.0001" condim="3" solref="0.01 1.0"/>
    </flexcomp>
  </worldbody>
  <equality><connect name="grip_a_slot0" body1="grip_a" body2="cloth_0" anchor="0 0 0" active="false" solref="0.01 1"/>
<connect name="grip_a_slot1" body1="grip_a" body2="cloth_0" anchor="0 0 0" active="false" solref="0.01 1"/>
<connect name="grip_a_slot2" body1="grip_a" body2="cloth_0" anchor="0 0 0" active="false" solref="0.01 1"/>
<connect name="grip_a_slot3" body1="grip_a" body2="cloth_0" anchor="0 0 0" active="false" solref="0.01 1"/>
<connect name="grip_b_slot0" body1="grip_b" body2="cloth_0" anchor="0 0 0" active="false" solref="0.01 1"/>
<connect name="grip_b_slot1" body1="grip_b" body2="cloth_0" anchor="0 0 0" active="false" solref="0.01 1"/>
<connect name="grip_b_slot2" body1="grip_b" body2="cloth_0" anchor="0 0 0" active="false" solref="0.01 1"/>
<connect name="grip_b_slot3" body1="grip_b" body2="cloth_0" anchor="0 0 0" active="false" solref="0.01 1"/></equality>
</mujoco>
